content: Always ask for direct confirmation before starting any implementation or writing code. Never begin coding without explicit approval.

When using the edit tool, never construct oldText from memory. Always read the file immediately before editing (same turn or previous assistant message). Copy oldText verbatim from the read output — do not reconstruct it. If the file has been edited since the last read, re-read the exact region first. Never retry the same oldText after a "not found" error without re-reading the file.
Before building or debugging, always check relevant memories first — they may have rules, gotchas, or patterns that prevent mistakes.
